classification_policy: Each bundled row is classified exactly once: “warning” is an exact-key inline caution; “no_warning” means no separate caution was judged warranted. Placeholder highlighting is generic and is not counted as a curated warning.

warnings.git switch <branch>: Changes the checked-out branch; confirm uncommitted work is safe to carry over.
warnings.git switch -c <branch>: Creates and checks out a branch; confirm the starting point.
warnings.git add <file>: Stages the selected file for a later commit; review the staged diff.
warnings.git commit -m '<message>': Creates a commit from the staged changes; review them first.
warnings.git fetch: Contacts the remote and updates remote-tracking refs; it does not update the working tree.
warnings.git stash push: Moves tracked working changes into a stash; verify what will be saved.

warnings.ssh <user>@<host>: Connects to a remote host; verify its host key before trusting the session.
warnings.ssh -p <port> <host>: Connects to a remote host on a non-default port; verify its host key before trusting the session.
warnings.ssh -i <key> <host>: Uses the selected identity file; keep private-key material confidential.
warnings.ssh -v <host>: Verbose diagnostics can reveal hostnames and connection details; review before sharing.
warnings.ssh -G <host>: Prints resolved SSH configuration, which may reveal internal hostnames, users or identity paths.
warnings.ssh -L 8080:localhost:80 <host>: Forwards a local port to a remote service; confirm the destination and who can reach the local port.
warnings.ssh -N -D 1080 <host>: Creates a SOCKS proxy that can route application traffic through the remote host.

warnings.curl -o <file> <url>: Writes to the named local file and may replace its contents.
warnings.curl -v <url>: Verbose output may reveal request headers or credentials; review before sharing.
warnings.curl --json @data.json <url>: Sends a POST request; the remote service may create or change data.

warnings.tmux attach: Attaches to an existing session; its contents may be visible and input affects that session.

warnings.dd: Deletes the current line from the buffer; use Vim undo if needed.
warnings.:w / :q / :wq: The write forms save the buffer to disk and may replace file contents.

warnings.Ctrl+R: Searches shell history through fzf integration; treat displayed history as private.
warnings.fzf --preview 'head -80 {}': Runs a preview command and displays file contents; avoid exposing private files.

warnings.rg --hidden '<pattern>': Includes hidden files that may contain private configuration or credentials.

warnings.fd -H '<pattern>': Includes hidden paths that may contain private configuration or credentials.
warnings.fd -I '<pattern>': Includes ignored paths that may contain generated or private files.

warnings.F9 / k: Sends a signal to the selected process; this can terminate it.

warnings.Ctrl+Shift+V: Pastes clipboard contents into the terminal; inspect it before pressing Enter.
warnings.Ctrl+Shift+W: Closes the current terminal tab and its foreground session may end.
